CONVERT(Type, Target)](#249eda9b0fe1809caebfe786728ddb64) > - [3. 합성](#249eda9b0fe180e69d44c82442685ff3) ## 변환형 함수 ( SQL Server ) > ✏️ > > 1. CAST ( expression AS data_type [ ( length ) ] > > 1. CONVERT ( data_type [ ( length ) ], expression [ , style ] ) ### 1. CAST() ```sql # SQL Server SELECT CAST('20.99' as float), # 결과: 20.99 CAST(20 as vachar(2)), # 결과: '20' CAST(getdate() AS char), # 결과: 'Agu 8 2025 21:09PM' FROM dual ``` ### 2. CONVERT(Type, Target) ```sql # SQL Server SELECT CONVERT(varchar, getdate(), 14) # 결과: '21:08:25' ( 시간만 표시 ) CONVERT(varchar, getdate(), 1) # 결과: '2025-08-08' ( 날짜만 표시 ) CONVERT(varchar, getdate(), 120) # 결과: '2025-08-08 21:08:25' ( ODBC 표준 ) CONVERT(int, '20') # 결과: 20 CONVERT(float, '20.99') # 결과: 20.99 CONVERT(varchar, 20) # 결과: '20' FROM dual ``` ### 3. 합성 ```sql # SQL Server SELECT CONVERT(datetime, CAST(getdate() AS char)), # 결과: '2025-08-08 21:08:25' CAST( CAST(getdate() AS char) as datetime) # 결과: '2025-08-08 21:08:25' FROM dual ```
